_about: Per-file sound options. 'slices': cut one exported sound into several app sounds (seconds; null end = to the end). 'keep_source': also install the whole file under its own name. 'cues': named moments (seconds in THIS file) the app syncs animation to; tools/process_assets.py corrects them for the silence it trims. The source files stay untouched.

book-magic._note: the magical pad: plays while Twilight runs through the stacks

page-turn._note: the page turn: lands when the book opens; also used for chapters and cross-reference cards

spike-burp.wav._note: pop = the scroll/letter appearing; Spike's Scroll pops the scroll on this cue
